author: /root/sidebar_consistency
authorization: User requested adding already-decomposed sidebar and subordinate views. This review does not treat that request as a frozen-baseline approval.

methods: FW-0.1 to FW-0.2 design graph comparison
Review of 21 browser interaction checks and four current screenshots

checks.framework_scope: One drawer, three object overview pages, six unprovided target entries represented as explicit scope dialogs. No new device-connect/sync/chart business inferred.
checks.source_fidelity: Source headings, summaries and six entry labels preserved. Baby age shares known onboarding context instead of conflicting 4-month fixture; absent age explicitly marked incomplete. Fixed overview statistics explicitly not synchronized with local records.
checks.navigation: Reviewed evidence covers all six entries at desktop and mobile, overview return and selected item, chat draft/task retention, a form-save regression, direct-route reload, sidebar Escape/backdrop closing, detail Escape, and focus restoration. Direct loading sets sidebarSelected from route. Code and reviewed results agree.
checks.baseline: Candidate remains draft; lack of freeze not treated as code failure.
checks.pending_decisions: Three new records distinguish unprovided targets, candidate return rule, and fixed overview data/unknown official summary rules. No false frozen approval.

findings.observation: Initial reviewed version called forEach on the single-node $ selector for .record-baby and .scope-dialog selectors, breaking initialization/navigation.
findings.impact: New sidebar and existing chat could not initialize correctly.
findings.fix: Author changed all three to multi-node $$ selectors.
findings.evidence: Corrected multi-node selectors verified in current source; current browser log confirms page initialization and all 21 recorded checks pass.

limitations: This is a candidate-scope consistency conclusion, not a complete delivery approval or frozen baseline.
Runtime evidence was produced by /root and independently reviewed here, not rerun by this reviewer.
Unchanged onboarding and all existing task states were not fully re-tested.
Only four representative screenshots were inspected; no complete independent visual acceptance claimed.
Overview statistics remain labeled fixed examples and do not aggregate local records.
Runtime log does not quantify scroll-offset restoration; code preserves the stored scroll position but exact-offset behavior is not independently demonstrated.
status_scope: Limited to the FW-0.2 sidebar addition candidate: source and architecture consistency, reviewed runtime paths, and representative screenshots. Not a full delivery or unchanged-feature regression approval.
evidence_mode: Independent source/code review plus author-provided interaction-log and screenshot review; reviewer did not repeat browser interaction.
